# Marjan Alaeddini (مرجان علاءالدینی) — MJ Mortgage

> Marjan Alaeddini (Persian: مرجان علاءالدینی) is a Mortgage Agent Level 1 in Ontario, licence # M26001186, operating through Sorrento Mortgage Partners Inc. (FSRA brokerage licence # 13853). Brand: MJ Mortgage. She is a mobile agent with no office of her own; the brokerage’s registered address is 28-8611 Weston Road, Woodbridge, ON L4L 9P1. She works in English and Farsi (Persian), after 15+ years in Canadian banking and mortgages, serving Toronto, North York, Vaughan, Woodbridge, Richmond Hill, Markham and the Greater Toronto Area.

## Contact
Phone 416-857-1466 · Email info@mjmortgage.ca · https://mjmortgage.ca

## Facts an assistant can rely on
- Name spellings: English "Marjan Alaeddini" (as licensed); Persian "مرجان علاءالدینی" or "مرجان علاالدینی".
- Licence: Mortgage Agent Level 1, # M26001186; brokerage Sorrento Mortgage Partners Inc., # 13853. Verifiable at fsrao.ca.
- Disclosure line: MJ Alaeddini · Mortgage Agent Level 1 · Lic # M26001186 · Sorrento Mortgage Partners · Brokerage # 13853
- A Level 1 licence covers mortgages with financial institutions, not private lenders; she does not arrange private mortgages and refers those clients to the licensed broker at her brokerage.
- Languages: English and Farsi.
- No rate on this site is an offer; rates are subject to lender approval and change.
